title: Student App and Journey Integration
problemSolved: Students navigate a fragmented digital estate, and King’s does not yet have a coherent student-facing product and reusable app platform through which existing systems can be integrated around the journeys students are trying to complete.
whatChanges: King’s establishes and operates the Student Experience Hub as an evolving student app and shared platform, progressively integrating information, opportunities, actions and support while retaining authoritative source systems where appropriate.
